title: Console go‑live orchestration: activation scripts, training track, and cost transparency
creator: Aisha Martinez
description: Coordinate cross-functional sequence for go‑live of three Console UX features: per-route cost breakdown widget, controlled rollouts with cohort management, and an activation workflow for dashboards. Deliverables include activation scripts for Customer Success, microtraining materials, release notes package, and an internal pre-launch checklist.
acceptance_criteria: Activation script tested with internal pilot account and approved by CS lead
Microtraining (3 videos) uploaded to LMS and feedback form created
Release notes drafted and reviewed by Docs and Legal
Support runbook created and linked in internal KB
Feature flags and canary cohorts defined and validated in staging
tasks: Finalize copy for in-console activation modal (Design review by 2026-03-01)

Prepare release notes + changelog entry and translation tasks
Schedule cross-team launch readiness review (30 March)
